title: A morphism with image in an open subscheme factors uniquely through it
statement: Let $h:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subscheme with inclusion $j_U:U\to X$ (an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]) such that $h(T)\subseteq U$ as sets. Then there is a unique morphism of schemes $h':T\to U$ with $j_U\circ h'=h$. In particular, for a morphism $f:X\to S$ and open subschemes $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq S$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ there is a unique morphism $f_{U,V}:U\to V$ with $j_V\circ f_{U,V}=f\circ j_U$.
